name: plainly
description: Catch and fix LLM 'style smells' in non-fiction prose — quality signals, not an AI-detection verdict.
author: Mapika

name: paper-reader
description: Read research papers with strict per-claim citations. Fetches PDF + tex source + real BibTeX from open sources (OpenAlex, Crossref, DBLP, ACL, Semantic Scholar, arXiv). Never fabricates citations.
author: Mapika

name: nice-figures
description: Generate matplotlib figures in a soft-pastel, warm-earth, research-blog visual register — bold display titles, smoothed trends with shaded bands, rounded bars, minimal axes. Conference-ready white background by default.
author: Mapika

name: good-code
description: Teach appropriately-expressive backend code (Python/TS/Go): when to comment, abstract, validate, and handle errors. Every rule has a when-NOT guard, so it curbs LLM over-commenting/over-abstraction without overcorrecting into cryptic code. Bundles real before/after examples and a tripwire scanner.
author: Mapika
